unsupported_levels.easy: No rated easy source in the complete KP pull at basis 1968. Do not relabel moderate derivative questions as easy. Reopen classification with new source evidence.

moderate.policy: Power exponent n=2..21; quadratic-slope coefficient a=1..20; affine-slope intercept b=1..20. Scale derivative and symbolic polynomial blanks replay at original parameters only. All ln(ax) derivative tasks share one mathematical key, so coefficient or field-layout changes cannot inflate inventory.

hard.policy: Origin tangent coefficient a=2..21; translated tangent point t=1..20 with intercept t+1; scaled logarithm outer coefficient and tangent abscissa c=2..21. Complete banks remain separate.

capability.narrower_sampling_policy: Source families retained; finitely bounded integer extensions. Original values included. No assertion of unlimited capability.

source_exclusions.reason: Unrated, missing correct designation and worked solution
Unrated, missing correct designation and worked solution
Rated hard, but answer fields missing; no invented bank

plots.evidence: Complete source prompt, choices and solutions contain no mathematical image references.

capability.finite_limit_policy: Exclude existing source/canonical and historical question content, not merely UUIDs. If fewer than five validated distinct never-shown unreserved tasks remain at a supported level, report finite-limit with explicit shortage.

note: Supported moderate/hard reserves verified using distinct mathematical tasks. Easy has no rated source evidence and remains an explicit capability exception. Unrated/incomplete originals preserved and excluded; learner history untouched.
